name: harness-event-inbox-spliced

messages.text: Check the changelog for the pinned commit.
Then open a draft pull request.

notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:400-403 and 338-355: one splice event carries the user-role messages it inserted, in insertion order, each with the producer-declared source (user, goal, webhook, ...; unknown when the journal carries no readable source). DSH agent/inbox/spliced drops blocks with empty text and emits nothing for an empty splice (DSHEventMapper.swift:67-73, 128-130).
